top_news.title: Anthropic Reports Claude Now Handles 95% of Internal Analytics Queries
top_news.dek: Anthropic reports that 95% of its internal analytics queries are now handled by Claude.
top_news.brief: The company attributes this high adoption rate to robust data governance, clear semantic definitions, and operational discipline rather than model improvements alone. By enabling employees to query business data independently, Anthropic has significantly reduced the reliance on dedicated data teams for routine analysis.
top_news.image_alt: Dashboard showing automated data analytics query results

top_news.title: Cisco AI Introduces FAPO: Pipeline-Aware Prompt Optimization With Step-Level Failure Attribution and Claude Code Orchestration
top_news.dek: Cisco open-sourced FAPO, a system designed to automate prompt optimization for multi-step LLM pipelines.
top_news.brief: FAPO (Fully Automated Prompt Optimization) uses Claude Code to identify failures at specific steps in an LLM chain. It then iterates on prompts, parameters, and structural logic, validating improvements through an independent reviewer to boost overall pipeline accuracy.
top_news.image_alt: Flowchart illustrating the FAPO automated optimization loop

top_news.title: Show HN: Recall – Local project memory for Claude Code
top_news.dek: Recall provides durable, offline memory for Claude Code to reduce token usage and context re-explanation.
top_news.brief: Recall is a local memory management tool designed for Claude Code. It allows developers to maintain project context across sessions without relying on cloud-based storage, helping to optimize token consumption and streamline development workflows.
top_news.image_alt: Recall project memory tool logo and badge

top_news.title: Samsung Electronics brings ChatGPT and Codex to employees
top_news.dek: Samsung Electronics has deployed ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to its global workforce.
top_news.brief: Samsung is rolling out OpenAI's enterprise tools to all employees in Korea and its Device eXperience division worldwide. The deployment covers R&D, manufacturing, and corporate operations, marking one of the largest enterprise-scale adoptions of OpenAI technology to date.
top_news.image_alt: Samsung and OpenAI partnership announcement graphic

top_news.title: AgentX - AI Agent evaluation framework
top_news.dek: AgentX is a framework for building and evaluating multi-agent AI systems using any LLM.
top_news.brief: AgentX provides a structured environment for developers to construct and test multi-agent workflows. It focuses on evaluation capabilities, allowing teams to benchmark agent performance across different LLM backends.

primary.title: AI is inflating student grades, and the effect points to outsourced work, not better learning

The article AI is inflating student grades, and the effect points to outsourced work, not better learning appeared first on The Decoder.

primary.title: Crawlee for Python: Build a Web Crawling Pipeline with Robots Handling, Link Graphs, and RAG Chunk Export
primary.summary: In this tutorial, we build a complete Crawlee for Python workflow from setup to AI-ready output. We generate a local demo website, then crawl it with BeautifulSoupCrawler, ParselCrawler, and PlaywrightCrawler. We extract titles, metadata, product fields, and JavaScript-rendered cards, and capture full-page screenshots. We then normalize the data, build a link graph, and export JSON, CSV, and RAG-ready JSONL chunks. The post Crawlee for Python: Build a Web Crawling Pipeline with Robots Handling, Link Graphs, and RAG Chunk Export appeared first on MarkTechPost.
